column1: # ZAP baseline rules for the AXON HTTP server (#74).
# 10049 fires in BOTH directions: "Storable and Cacheable Content" when a
# response has no cache directive, and "Non-Storable Content" when it does.
# axon/http/app.py sets Cache-Control: no-store globally, so this plugin now
# reports the desired behaviour and would fail the gate for being correct.
# Cache regression is NOT left uncovered by this line: tests/http/test_cache_headers.py
# /dashboard and the 404 — wider coverage than the baseline scan, which only
# reaches the root. That test runs on every PR; this scan runs once per push.

column3: both directions of this alert are non-actionable here; see tests/http/test_cache_headers.py
